reward.text: The round-window perch is yours to lounge on, and Mother's bottle-cap hoard is uncovered in the nest.

objectives.text: A raccoon family has moved into the attic of 255 Massey. Drive out Mother Raccoon — she guards the nest in the far corner, and her kits will nip at your heels while she lives. The kits are optional; Mother is not.
objectives.title: Reclaim the attic
